evals.prompt: Put design-spec.md and a few screenshots from ~/Downloads onto the canvas for preview, then open the local service so I can view them.
evals.expected_output: Uses the canvas CLI, imports supported Markdown/image files as nodes, starts the service on port 3020, and reports the preview URL.

evals.prompt: Symlink my Downloads folder into the canvas directory, then add only example.html and hero.png to the canvas without copying the original files.
evals.expected_output: Uses link plus add, avoids import for the specific files, and returns node ids/paths in JSON or a concise summary.

evals.prompt: Create a new Markdown prompt draft node so I can edit it in the right-side inspector. Also tell me how a future Agent can read this node's context.
evals.expected_output: Uses the markdown command to create a blank Markdown node, explains context/list/read commands, and does not create an unrelated prompt node.
